question: Which Raman mode showed the largest mean red shift when the V2O5 film was prestrained, by how much, and which mode shifted the other way?
rendered:
According to the document, when the V2O5 film was prestrained, the mean red shift of the Raman modes was as follows:

- V-O1 (∼997 cm^−1) showed a mean red shift of ∼2 cm^−1
- V-O3-V (∼483 cm^−1) showed a mean red shift of ∼3.5 cm^−1
- V-O2 (∼708 cm^−1) showed a mean red shift of ∼5 cm^−1
- V-O2 (∼303 cm^−1) showed a mean blue shift of 1 cm^−1
